Universal button mnemonics

Source: R/universal_buttons.R
universal_buttons.Rd

One-character symbol per universal-button slot. Length 40. Indexed by slot number using one-based R semantics: slot 1 = "R" (Right), slot 8 = "A", and so on. Slots 31..40 are the Intellivision / ColecoVision numeric keypad (digits 0-9). INTV's Enter/Clear and Coleco's Star/Pound do not have dedicated slots — they fold into Start (slot 5) and Select (slot 6) since they're functionally Start/Select on those platforms (pressed once at boot).

Usage

universal_buttons()

Value

Character vector of length 40.

Details

See also

universal_button_names()

Examples

universal_buttons()
#>  [1] "R" "L" "D" "U" "T" "S" "B" "A" "x" "y" "p" "q" "C" "Z" "M" "#" ">" "<" "v"
#> [20] "^" "e" "f" "n" "g" "w" "h" "s" "i" "[" "]" "0" "1" "2" "3" "4" "5" "6" "7"
#> [39] "8" "9"
